field.label: NetSuite Base url
field.comment: The base url as you access it via the browser, e.g. https://system.na1.netsuite.com/

field.label: Inventory mode
field.comment: Single location maps NetSuite stock onto the default Magento source. Multiple locations maps each NetSuite location onto its own Magento source.

field.label: Enable getting product data from NetSuite
Enable getting product images from NetSuite
Enable sending customers changes to NetSuite
Enable getting customer data from NetSuite
Enable getting order changes from NetSuite
Enable getting cash sale/invoice data from NetSuite
Enable importing credit memos from NetSuite
Enable importing cash refunds from NetSuite
Enable getting shipment data from NetSuite
Enable getting stock updates from NetSuite
Cache lists and custom records for
field.comment: Number of seconds

field.label: Field Mapping
field.comment: Map Magento product attributes to NetSuite fields. For "standard" NetSuite fields, see the InventoryItem object in SuiteTalk documentation

field.label: Price level to grab the price from
field.comment: The price levels are visble at Setup->Accounting->Accounting Lists, then switch to "Price level"

field.label: Product Special Price Import Behavior
field.comment: Make sure that Special Price Price level is set after enabling this setting.

field.label: Special Price Price level
field.comment: The price levels are visble at Setup->Accounting->Accounting Lists, then switch to "Price level"

field.label: New product default attribute set id
Push line items with fixed price bundles
field.comment: Note that if this is set to yes, it is possible that stock will be deduced twice for the line items - once for the bundle and once for the separate line items

field.label: Related Products Field Name
field.comment: This field should contain comma-separated internal IDs of related products

field.label: Upsells Field Name
field.comment: This field should contain comma-separated internal IDs of upsell products

field.label: Eav Attributes to Strip HTML Tags
field.comment: For security purpose we can strip html tags for product Attributes on import from NS. If list of tags is empty - we strip all html tags.

field.label: NS attributes for images
field.comment: This field should contain comma-separated internal IDs of the NS attributes for Images to be imported

field.label: NS attributes for base image
field.comment: Base image NS ID - it should be among IDs listed on the whole list of image IDs

field.label: Compare image file name before import
Price Level Mapping
field.comment: To see the defined Price Levels in NetSuite and their internal IDs, go to Setup->Accounting->Accounting Lists, then change type to "Price Level"

field.label: Export message limit
field.comment: The maximum number of messages that are to be exported (sent to) NetSuite in a single cron run

field.label: Import message limit
field.comment: The maximum number of messages that are to be imported (processed from) NetSuite in a single cron run

field.label: Timeout
field.comment: In case processing an element fails, the element is added back to the queue. The timeout specifies the number of seconds that needs to pass so the item is considered for re-processing

field.label: Import items updated in last N minutes
field.comment: The import queue will consider only items updated in at most this number of minutes

field.label: Delete existing items in import queue
field.comment: If this is set to Yes, then whenever an item is imported and it already exists in the queue, it get deleted and re-added. Useful in cases where items are frequently imported with incomplete information the first time

field.label: Remove Monitoring Item if processed successfully
field.comment: If this is set to Yes, then the Monitoring Dashboard will NOT include items that processed successfully. This should be enabled only for initial setup or debugging

field.label: Level of information to be saved
Clean up Entries older then X days
field.comment: 0 means every day. Range 0-30. This includes all entries except "In Queue" ones.

field.label: Developer E-mail
field.comment: Warning emails will be sent to this email address. You can add multuple addresses and separte them by comma.

field.label: E-mail errors and exceptions
field.comment: E-mail will be sent to the configured developer email above.

field.label: Export queue threshold
field.comment: If the export queue has more elements than defined here, an email is sent to the developer. An ever-growing queue is a sign of processing being stuck. Set to zero to disable.

field.label: Import queue threshold
field.comment: If the import queue has more elements than defined here, an email is sent to the developer. An ever-growing queue is a sign of processing being stuck. Set to zero to disable.

field.label: Warn if import not run after (hours)
field.comment: If this is set, it shows a System Message in Admin if Import process hasn't ran for X hours. Value 0 disables it.

field.label: Warn if export not run after (hours)
field.comment: If this is set, it shows a System Message in Admin if Export process hasn't ran for X hours. Value 0 disables it.

field.label: Warn if stock not run after (hours)
field.comment: If this is set, it shows a System Message in Admin if Stock process hasn't ran for X hours. Value 0 disables it.

field.label: NetSuite Customer "Export to Magento" Field Id
field.comment: NetSuite Customer Custom Field Id that marks Customer as importable to Magento

field.label: Default Store
field.comment: Customer Store scope when importing from NetSuite (add and update)

field.label: Default Customer Group
field.comment: Customer Group that is set when importing data from NetSuite (add and update)

field.label: Required Address Fields
field.comment: Select which fields must be set on NetSuite Customer Address for import. For missing fields, default values will be used, check module config.xml to see their values

field.label: Login Message
field.comment: When Customer imported from NetSuite tries to Login, a custom message will be shown. The message template is located in our module and can be changed thru standard Magento practices.

field.label: Registration Message
field.comment: When Customer imported from NetSuite tries to Register, a custom message will be shown. The message template is located in our module and can be changed thru standard Magento practices.

field.label: Order Location Id
field.comment: Location where the Sales Order Items are placed on Order Export. The list is available at Setup->Company->Locations in NetSuite. If not set - Location isn't added

field.label: Custom fields that are to be synched between Magento and NetSuite
field.comment: Define the fields in NetSuite at Setup->Customization->Transaction body fields. We only support the freetext type.

field.label: Default discount item internal id
field.comment: Create one at Lists->Accounting->Items

field.label: Select Where to Export the Discount
Add Discount Per Item
field.comment: For each Item, additional line with Discount will be added.

field.label: Add Promotion Data for each Item
field.comment: The connector discount support adds two custom columns on SalesOrder to ItemList which are used for better Discount reporting. If you want to use this, set to Yes.

field.label: Mapping between Magento and NetSuite payment methods
field.comment: To see the defined shipping methods in NetSuite and their internal IDs, go to Setup->Accounting->Accounting Lists, then change type to "Payment method"

field.label: Mapping between Magento payment methods and NetSuite payment processors
field.comment: To see the defined credit card processors in NetSuite and their internal IDs, go to Setup->Accounting->Credit Card Processing

field.label: Not Taxable" code internal NetSuite id
field.comment: The id can be found in NetSuite at Setup->Accounting->Tax Groups

field.label: Tax item internal NetSuite id
field.comment: Tax will be passed as a separate line item to mitigate the need of configuring taxes both in Magento and NS. Create an item at Lists > Website > Items and add it's internal ID here

field.label: Sales Order Field to add Tax Amount for order
field.comment: The Field should be created in Customization menu of NetSuite.

field.label: Sales Order Field to add Total Amount for order
field.comment: The Field should be created in Customization menu of NetSuite.

field.label: Mapping between Magento and NetSuite shipping methods
field.comment: To see the defined shipping methods in NetSuite and their internal IDs, go to Lists->Accounting->Shipping Items

field.label: If none of the rules above match, use this NetSuite shipping item internal id:
field.comment: To see the defined shipping methods in NetSuite and their internal IDs, go to Lists->Accounting->Shipping Items

field.label: Mapping between Magento Tracking number types and Netsuite shipping methods
field.comment: To see the defined shipping methods in Netsuite and their internal IDs, go to Lists->Accounting->Shipping Items

field.label: Send tracking information when receiving tracking numbers from NetSuite
Location Internal Id
field.comment: This config is ignored for Inventory Multi Management NSC setup

field.label: Stock stored at location level?
field.comment: Set this to no if stock is stored in a custom field at product level. Set it to yes if it is stored in a custom or standard field at location level. This config is ignored for Inventory Multi Management NSC setup

field.label: Quantity field name
field.comment: Used when grabbing stock data from the saved search (on stock updates)

field.label: Update the stocks every N minutes
Saved stock search internal id
field.comment: A custom search must be defined to allow stock updates. This has a very specific format. Refer to the documentation on how to create one.

field.label: Page size for the saved search query
Change stock status when under zero items
field.comment: Whether to set the stock status to "Out of stock" when reaching zero, or not set this option at all
